subject: Ciências
description_pt: Identificar características da Terra (como seu formato esférico, a presença de água, solo etc.), com base na observação, manipulação e comparação de diferentes formas de representação do planeta (mapas, globos, fotografias etc.).

components.description_pt: Identificar a forma esférica da Terra em diferentes representações como mapas, globos e fotografias
components.description_en: Identify Earth's spherical shape from different representations such as maps, globes, and photographs
components.cc_component_description: Explain how maps represent the spatial arrangement of Earth's surface features

components.description_pt: Identificar características da Terra como presença de água e solo em várias representações
components.description_en: Identify characteristics of Earth such as the presence of water and soil from various representations
components.cc_component_description: Obtain information from texts or media to describe the distribution of water across Earth's surface

components.description_pt: Comparar diferentes representações da Terra para identificar suas características físicas
components.description_en: Compare different representations of Earth to identify its physical characteristics
components.cc_component_description: Compare patterns of Earth's features across different map types to draw evidence-based conclusions

cc_matches.description: Obtain information to identify where water is found on Earth and that it can be solid or liquid.
Maps show where things are located. One can map the shapes and kinds of land and water in any area.
Analyze and interpret data from maps to describe patterns of Earth’s features.
